name: Daegu

queries.query: 대구 지적도 토지임야도 열람 지적(임야)도 Daegu official
queries.scope: Find the authoritative Daegu cadastral/forest parcel-map viewer.
queries.result: Direct HTTP 200 inspection confirms the Daegu KRAS cadastral/forest map page is live. It offers parcel-location and lot/address inquiry with Daegu selected at the city level; no target parcel was selected or returned. The notice says the display may differ from official records and is not a legal certificate or survey source.
queries.executionMethod: Web search plus direct read-only HTTP inspection of the Daegu KRAS page and viewer form.

queries.query: 대구 연속지적도 WFS 공개 데이터 토지정보
queries.scope: Check for official open full-polygon data or a public feature service beyond the parcel viewer.
queries.result: The official Ministry of Land K-GeoP viewer exposes land and building information and asks users to select a parcel on the map; it states the map is for reference and has no legal effect. No anonymous full-polygon feature API or downloadable Daegu parcel layer was identified in the official results.

queries.query: Daegu cadastral parcel map official Korea land information system
queries.scope: Cross-check the service operator and public API availability in English.
queries.result: Search pointed to the Daegu city site, the national MOLIT K-GeoP map, and the Data.go.kr land/forest attribute API. The attribute API is not full parcel geometry and does not satisfy the sample requirement.

portals.name: Daegu KRAS cadastral/forest map inquiry
portals.operator: Daegu Metropolitan City land-information portal (KRAS integration page)
portals.observation: Direct HTTP 200 confirms the live Daegu cadastral/forest map viewer. City-level selector is Daegu; the form requires administrative/lot selection. Disclaimer warns the display may differ from official records and has no survey/legal-certificate status. No target polygon was selected.

portals.name: K-GeoP Internet map
portals.operator: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport / National Spatial Information Center
portals.observation: Interactive national land-information viewer. Static response says select a parcel on the map and notes the map has no legal effect; the target-coordinate URL could not be fetched through the web transport. No full polygon response was returned.

requests.observation: HTTP 200; title 지적(임야)도 열람. City selector is Daegu; UI exposes district/eup-myeon-dong/ri and parcel/address search. Disclaimer says displayed data can differ from official records and map cannot be used for surveying.
HTTP 200; same live city-specific cadastral viewer shell.
National MOLIT viewer page exposes parcel selection controls; no full target geometry was retrieved.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Daegu city KRAS cadastral/forest map viewer provides parcel/lot inquiry; national K-GeoP is an additional interactive reference viewer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: A city-specific cadastral viewer is live, but no WUP-point or other full parcel polygon was selected and verified.

technicalBlocker: No anonymous full-polygon response was verified after the inspected administrative parcel-selection flow. The legal/survey disclaimer is informational and does not block use.
remainingUncertainty: Whether the Daegu viewer can expose full polygon geometry publicly after selecting the target parcel; whether a separate official open full-polygon service exists.
nextStep: Use the viewer to resolve the WUP-point administrative unit and parcel, then inspect whether a complete parcel polygon is retrievable; retain the viewer disclaimer.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: The Daegu-operated KRAS viewer exposes city-specific cadastral/forest map inquiry and parcel selection; no full geometry was retrieved.
